project_type: Python NiceGUI web app with Strands Agents SDK, Amazon Bedrock Data Automation, and AWS CDK infrastructure
build_system: uv for dependency management, pyproject.toml for project config
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/idp && python -c "import ast; import glob; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in glob.glob('**/*.py', recursive=True)]"
verification_instructions: 1. Run AST parse on all Python files to verify syntax. 2. Run ruff check for linting. 3. Since INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, cannot pip install - verify code correctness via AST and static analysis only.
setup_instructions: Cannot install packages due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. All code is written to be correct but verification is limited to syntax checking and AST validation.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - cannot pip install, cannot pull Docker images, cannot access external registries. Python 3.11.14 available via pyenv. Node.js v22 available. uv, ruff, black, mypy, pyright, pytest available as pre-installed tools. All verification must use AST/syntax checks rather than runtime execution.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines. Follow standard Python conventions: pyproject.toml for config, type hints, docstrings.

key_patterns.strands_agent: Agent class with BedrockModel provider. callback_handler callable receives kwargs: reasoningText, data, complete, event. additional_request_fields={'thinking': {'type': 'enabled', 'budgetTokens': N}} enables reasoning. Model ID for Sonnet 4.5 US profile: 'us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250514-v1:0'. stream_async() yields events with data/reasoning text.
key_patterns.nicegui: ui.chat_message for chat bubbles. ui.run_javascript for scroll. @ui.page for routing. ui.upload for file uploads. ui.markdown for formatted text. asyncio integration with NiceGUI's event loop.
key_patterns.bedrock_data_automation: boto3 client 'bedrock-data-automation-runtime'. invoke_data_automation_async(inputConfiguration={'s3Uri': ...}, outputConfiguration={'s3Uri': ...}, dataAutomationProfileArn=...) returns invocationArn. get_data_automation_status(invocationArn=...) returns status, outputConfiguration with s3Uri for results.
key_patterns.s3_multipart: boto3 S3 client. create_multipart_upload, upload_part, complete_multipart_upload. Bucket name prefix: ntkey-.
key_patterns.aws_cdk: Python CDK stacks. S3 bucket with bucket_name starting with 'ntkey-'. IAM roles for Bedrock and S3 access.

relevant_files: app/main.py - NiceGUI application entry point with chat UI and document upload
app/agent.py - Strands Agent configuration with BedrockModel (Sonnet 4.5 US, reasoning enabled, streaming)
app/callback_handler.py - Custom callback handler for streaming to NiceGUI UI
app/tools/upload_document.py - S3 multipart upload tool for large documents
app/tools/analyze_document.py - Bedrock Data Automation tool for document analysis
cdk/stacks/idp_stack.py - CDK stack defining S3 bucket (ntkey- prefix), IAM roles, BDA resources
tests/test_agent.py - Unit tests for agent configuration
tests/test_tools.py - Unit tests for custom tools
directory_structure: idp/ - project root; app/ - NiceGUI application code; app/tools/ - Strands agent tools; cdk/ - AWS CDK infrastructure code; cdk/stacks/ - CDK stack definitions; tests/ - pytest unit tests
